content: VERIFIED from official docs (pm2.keymetrics.io signals-clean-restart, fetched 2026-09-08): on pm2 stop/restart PM2 sends SIGINT first (not SIGTERM; PM2_KILL_SIGNAL env changes it), then SIGKILL if the process has not exited within kill_timeout, whose DEFAULT IS 1600ms. Node apps must register a signal handler to drain work; with a handler pm2 reload becomes gracefulReload. wait_ready true plus process.send('ready') delays online status (listen_timeout default 3000ms). Windows has no signals; shutdown_with_message sends a process message instead. Implication: default PM2 kills a worker 1.6s into a deploy - in-flight BullMQ jobs become stalled and re-run.
